classifications.REGIONAL: Regional dust storm (area >= 1.6e6 km², duration > 3 sols)
classifications.LOCAL_FLUSHING: Cross-equatorial frontal flushing storm channel (Acidalia, Utopia, Arcadia)
classifications.CAP_EDGE: Polar cap sublimation edge thermal gradient storm
classifications.OROGRAPHIC: Topographic leeward / upslope volcanic plume storm (Tharsis, Elysium)

featured_tracks.name: 2018 Planet-Encircling Dust Event (PEDE / MY34)
affected_missions: Opportunity MER-B (Mission Termination at Sol 5111, Tau > 10.8)
Curiosity MSL (REMS observed daylight drop, Tau = 8.5)
Mars Odyssey THEMIS (Global atmospheric thermal inversion)
MRO MARCI & MCS (Global dust shroud tracking)

trajectory.note: Initial frontal convective lifting in northern Acidalia
Cross-equatorial flush surging into Arabia Terra
Engulfs Opportunity landing site in Meridiani Planum
Crosses into Gale Crater; Curiosity records severe tau spike
Global encirclement phase; covers Elysium & Hellas
Full planet-encircling veil (PEDE); complete solar obscuration

featured_tracks.summary: The catastrophic 2018 Global Dust Storm began as a localized Acidalia flushing storm that rapidly expanded across the dichotomy boundary into Meridiani Planum. Peak optical depth exceeded tau = 10.8, reducing solar array illumination below the survival threshold of the Opportunity rover and terminating its historic 14.5-year mission.

featured_tracks.name: 2007 Planet-Encircling Dust Event (PEDE / MY28)
affected_missions: Spirit MER-A (Gusev Crater power dropped to 148 Wh/sol)
Opportunity MER-B (Meridiani power dropped to 128 Wh/sol; survived in low-power deep sleep)

trajectory.note: Origin in Chryse lowlands during southern solstice
Impacts Opportunity at Meridiani Planum
Reaches Spirit at Gusev Crater across 180 degrees
Thermal coupling triggers secondary Hellas explosion
Envelops entire southern and equatorial latitudes

featured_tracks.summary: Dual-rover observed global storm. Both Spirit in Gusev and Opportunity in Meridiani went into critical survival mode as atmospheric opacity reached tau ~ 4.7. Ground temperatures experienced a 30°C reduction in diurnal range as airborne dust absorbed midday solar flux.

featured_tracks.name: 2001 Planet-Encircling Dust Event (PEDE / MY25)
affected_missions: Mars Global Surveyor (MGS MOC & Thermal Emission Spectrometer TES)
Hubble Space Telescope (Visible disc global obscuration)

trajectory.note: Hellas deep basin convective explosion at perihelion
Breaches northern Hellas rim into Hesperia Planum
Engulfs Syrtis Major and crosses Martian equator
Climatic teleconnection triggers Tharsis dust plumes
Complete global encirclement observed by MGS TES

featured_tracks.summary: First planet-encircling event monitored by modern thermal and imaging orbiters. MGS TES documented planetary atmospheric temperatures warming by over 40 K at 0.5 mbar altitude as aloft mineral dust absorbed sunlight, fundamentally reshaping Martian atmospheric circulation.

featured_tracks.name: MY35 Acidalia-Chryse Frontal Flushing Storm
affected_missions: InSight Lander (Observed high-frequency barometric front passage)
Mars 2020 landing site planning (Jezero downwind monitoring)
featured_tracks.summary: Classic cross-equatorial baroclinic flushing storm. High-latitude cold air pushed southward through the Acidalia topographic depression, lifting dense curtain dust fronts that surged into the equatorial zone.

featured_tracks.name: MY35 Hellas Basin Baroclinic Sequence
affected_missions: Curiosity MSL (Gale Crater background tau elevation to 1.4)
featured_tracks.summary: Deep convective vortex storm trapped within the 7 km deep Hellas impact basin. Circumpolar thermal winds whipped regolith off the floor, spreading east across Promethei Terra.

featured_tracks.name: MY36 Utopia Lowland Frontal Dust Storm
affected_missions: InSight APSS (Direct detection of frontal pressure drop and dust deposition)
Zhurong Mars Rover (Observed dust accumulation in southern Utopia)
featured_tracks.summary: Swept directly over Elysium Planitia and InSight Lander, contributing to significant solar panel dust accumulation that curtailed seismometer operations in late 2021.

featured_tracks.name: MY35 Syrtis Major / Jezero In-Situ Dust Front
affected_missions: Perseverance Rover (Pre-landing orbital characterization by MRO MARCI)
featured_tracks.summary: Regional slope storm propagating directly across Jezero Crater. Thermal inertia contrasts between dark volcanic basalt in Syrtis and bright phyllosilicates in Jezero delta stimulated local boundary-layer winds.

featured_tracks.name: MY34 Argyre South Polar Cap-Edge Flusher
affected_missions: MRO MCS (Observed mid-atmospheric dust heating at 25-40 km)
featured_tracks.summary: Intense polar cap sublimation storm that carved northward from Argyre into eastern Coprates and Capri Chasma, channeling high-velocity dust plumes through Valles Marineris.

featured_tracks.name: MY34 Mount Sharp Katabatic Slope Plume
affected_missions: Curiosity MSL (REMS & Mastcam in-situ tau measurement)
featured_tracks.summary: Localized slope-flow event inside Gale Crater as the 2018 global storm approached. Curiosity REMS recorded atmospheric pressure drops and daytime surface temperature collapse.

featured_tracks.name: MY33 Solis Planum Regional Vortex Shroud
affected_missions: Curiosity MSL (Recorded elevated atmospheric dust haze)
Mars Express HRSC regional color imaging
featured_tracks.summary: Large regional eddy over the high-elevation Thaumasia volcanic plateau. The storm drifted east-northeast, blanketing Solis Planum before dissipating into Valles Marineris.
